blocks.title: Observer pattern
blocks.text: The Observer design pattern is like a group of people interested in updates from one source: whenever something important happens, the source automatically notifies all the interested people. It keeps things in sync without everyone constantly checking for updates.

blocks.prompt: Why is the Observer pattern better than having every object keep checking the source?
blocks.explanation: Constant checking wastes work and can still miss changes between checks; with the Observer pattern the source sends each update once to all observers as soon as it happens.

items: Observer: the source notifies all interested parties automatically when something changes; no constant checking.
